itemImport.title: Import drugs from a spreadsheet
itemImport.intro: Add up to {max} drugs at once from a CSV file (save your Excel sheet as CSV). Nothing is saved until you confirm.
itemImport.step1: and fill one drug per row. Column names can be in English, Amharic or Afaan Oromo.
itemImport.step2: Save it as CSV (in Excel: File, Save as, CSV UTF-8).
itemImport.step3: Choose the file below, check the list, then create the drugs. Add stock after with Receive.
itemImport.fileHint: Needed columns: name, unit, price, cost. Units: strip, bottle, sachet, tube, tablet, pack, piece, pair, roll, bag.
itemImport.done: {count, plural, one {# drug added.} other {# drugs added.}} Their stock is 0 until you receive a delivery.
